24.original: Show the speude bradeos figurine to people in Poieten Oikos and find who gave the shark its name.

25.original: Return the speude bradeos figurine to the Mitron creator.

48.original: Greetings, I am a researcher from the Words of Mitron. I've dedicated my life to studying and creating aquatic life, but my main focus is the development of new shark species.

49.original: My latest creation has completed its round of observation at Anagnorisis, and will be released after one final test.

50.original: The thing is, I'm hoping to consult with a taxonomist before the Bureau of the Architect hands down its official registration.

51.original: ...The same one who named my last shark, if I can─“speude bradeos” was such a marvelous name.

52.original: It turns out it's rather difficult to track down a specific person in a place such as this. Could you help me?

53.original: Thank you. Here, take this─it's a model of the previous creation I just mentioned. Whoever named it should hopefully be able to recognize it.

54.original: Show the shark to as many people as you can. Whoever recognizes it must be the one who named it.

55.original: Was there something I could help you with?

56.original: ...Who named this species? I'm sorry but I haven't a clue. Certainly not me.

57.original: What have we here? A roaming familiar?

58.original: Ah, yes, the speude bradeos. I've heard of it before, but I'm afraid I don't know who named it...

60.original: Oh, a speude bradeos! Of course I know it─I named it, after all!

61.original: Its creator was calling it a “cladoselache,” but I decided to go with something more closely tied to its distinct way of moving.

62.original: I wanted to really capture the image of it rushing forward with its tiny steps, somehow swift and slow at once.

63.original: In case you were curious, the name comes from a proverb meaning “more haste, less speed.”

64.original: And if the creator wishes me to name her newest creation, I would of course be honored to do so. It's in Anagnorisis, you say? I look forward to seeing it soon!

65.original: I honestly have no idea who gave that shark a name.

66.original: That creation is named so perfectly. If only I could come up with something so clever.

67.original: Oh, I can hardly wait to name this next shark creation!

69.original: You found him? And he's willing to give the new one a name, too? That is wonderful news!

70.original: This latest creation is actually a direct improvement over the last. I gave it more legs for a total of eight so it can move even <hex:021A020203>more<hex:021A020103> quickly over land.

71.original: With that taken care of, I need to hurry back to Anagnorisis. But before I go... Here. A token of my gratitude.
